{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Cortex System is a generic RPG system based on the \"Sovereign Stone System \", and was developed by Margaret Weis Productions, Ltd for the Serenity Role Playing Game.","title":"Cortex System"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It was subsequently used for their licensed \"Battlestar Galactica\" and Supernatural RPGs, and brought out as a stand-alone system in the \"Cortex System Role Playing Game\" book (also called the \"Cortex Classic System Role Playing Game\").","title":"Cortex System"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Serenity, using the Cortex System, was the 2005 Origins Award Gamer's Choice Role Playing Game of the Year.","title":"Cortex System"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Hiromichi Tanaka (田中 弘道 , Tanaka Hiromichi , born January 7, 1962) is a Japanese video game developer, game producer, game director and game designer.","title":"Hiromichi Tanaka"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" He was Senior Vice President of Software Development at Square Enix (formerly Square) and the head of the company's Product Development Division-3.","title":"Hiromichi Tanaka"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" He is best known as the former lead developer of \"Final Fantasy XI\", Square's first massively multiplayer online role playing game (MMORPG).","title":"Hiromichi Tanaka"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" He oversaw ongoing development of that title and \"Final Fantasy XIV\" until late 2010.","title":"Hiromichi Tanaka"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" He also recently led the development of the Nintendo DS version of \"Final Fantasy III\", having worked in a senior role on the original version of the game in 1990.","title":"Hiromichi Tanaka"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"What was the name of the founder and president of the company which produced the role playing game FTL:2448?"}
